description: Waits under 30 minutes (a 20-minute quick pickle, a 15-minute marinade) are mise with hands-off time, not ahead. Heavy front-loaded mise.

steps: Thinly slice the red onion and put it in a jar with the vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of the salt. Let it stand for 20 minutes.
Mince the garlic, zest and juice one lime, and cut the other into wedges.
Toss the shrimp with the lime zest and juice, the garlic, chili powder, half the oil, and the rest of the salt, and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes per side, until pink.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, shrimp, avocado, pickled onion, and cilantro, and serve with the lime wedges.
